boundary_rule: strict outside, inclusive transition; exact decimal Fraction comparisons
proposal: rank missing-region reference slots; estimate (T-slack)/(1-reference) from every observed complete point; bounded one-percent nudges, then bounded largest-gap fallback
rounding: nearest integer ps, ties upward; clip to registered bounds before finite nudges
nonmonotonic_response: retain all valid points, no monotonicity or continuity assumed, no inferred labels
stop: three spread points per region, thirteen targets including failures/locators, first failure, or finite proposal exhaustion
shortfall: counts, actual target/ratio spans, deviations and stop reason; never claim nonexistent regions
test_policy: pure decision function never admits EDA or test reads; future runner must verify dependency/model freeze before any locked_test execution
